Title: Apply valid code reduces subtotal by 10 percent
Preconditions: Cart with eligible items; code SAVE10 active at 10%
Steps: 1. Open checkout with 100.00 subtotal. 2. Enter SAVE10. 3. Apply code.
Expected Result: Discount line shows -10.00; total updates to 90.00 plus shipping

Title: Invalid code rejected and total unchanged
Preconditions: Cart ready; code NOTREAL does not exist
Steps: 1. Enter NOTREAL in the code field. 2. Apply.
Expected Result: Error message shown; no discount line; total unchanged

Title: Expired code rejected with clear message
Expected Result: Error states the code expired; total unchanged

Title: Second code replaces the first
Expected Result: SAVE10 removed; only FREESHIP active on the order

Title: Discount never applied to shipping cost
Removing applied code restores original total
Expected Result: Discount line disappears; original total restored

Title: Error message readable by screen reader
Expected Result: Error announced via aria-live region; focus moved to error
